conclusions: Skip store.resolve only when existing ordinary-descendant fast path is chosen, store has exact native platform Path type, is absolute, and contains no .. components. All checks lexical and request-local; no metadata/path cache.

Subclasses retain ordinary_descendant=False and original store dispatch/resolution. Absolute outside or traversal parts, custom Path store, relative/mutated parent roots retain original store.resolve.

Fresh full candidate ancestry link/junction/metadata guard remains before selection and candidate.resolve. Candidate.resolve(strict=False) and exact containment predicate unchanged. All recovery/atomic/UOW/approval/checkpoint/durability behavior unchanged.

For normal native canonical roots and fixed store child, retained candidate resolution catches outside ancestor swaps against lexical store; removed prefix resolve is not a lost authorization boundary.
Existing root normalization and separate store property/contained method unaffected.
retained_limits: No identical transient filesystem observation or injected-error chronology guarantee: removed prefix resolve call on eligible ordinary paths changes error timing and artificial prefix-specific failure hooks. Retained ancestry and candidate resolution errors fail closed.
Existing TOCTOU limits remain, no race-free filesystem guarantee.

Windows ordinary case comparisons follow native Path equality. Exotic aliases that change resolved spelling can produce stronger rejection; no exhaustive supported alias parity demonstrated without fixtures.
Deliberate absolute native root replacement with no .. is still treated according to the constructor’s root selection contract; no extra fresh root canonicalization/cache introduced.
Exact proposal unapplied/unqualified at capture. Targeted changed-root/custom Path/subclass/link/permission/containment cases required before applied PASS claim.
No original5s PLAN acceptance/13-of14 closure, performance speedup, complete contracts, installed/two-round qualification or release readiness claim.
